messages:
julia_partners: Quick heads-up — GCP Marketplace reviewer pinged us. They want a SOC2 summary + a firmware attestation for the Edge Gateway partner build before we can publish the listing. Also asking for a short pen-test summary (one page) and an inventory of uploaded artifacts.

mike_security: Ack. Do we already have a SOC2 summary we can redact and hand over? If not, I'll draft a 1-page extract. Who owns the firmware attestation from the HW SI side?

anil_eng: The firmware attestation lives with the HW partner (EdgeWorks) — they committed to an HSM-signed manifest last quarter. I have their contact and the signed blob. Need to check redaction rules before sharing.

sam_fieldeng: I can pull the EdgeWorks manifest and the presigned S3 link. Note: marketplace requires docs to be available for 90 days post-listing. Also they want a contact for on-call during the review window.

julia_partners: Great. Owners: mike — SOC2 extract + pen-test one-pager. anil — get the signed firmware manifest and confirm HSM key ID. sam — upload artifacts to the partnership bucket and add TTL metadata. I'll coordinate the GCP reviewer email and embargo timing for the joint announcement.

mike_security: Plan: draft SOC2 extract by EOD tomorrow, pen-test summary by Friday. Will include: scope, dates, critical findings (redacted), remediation status, and contact for the assessor.

anil_eng: I have the manifest but need EdgeWorks to approve a redacted version. I'll ping them now: @edgeworks-ops. If they don't approve by Thu noon, we can provide a signed hash + attestation letter instead.

sam_fieldeng: Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-partner-evidence/edgeworks/marketplace/1780045555/ now. Will request presigned URLs with 7-day TTL for the reviewer; label files with `classification=partner-evidence` and `retain-days=90`.

deploy-bot: Automated reminder: Please attach a short README in the artifact bundle describing redactions and who to contact for unredacted review (if required).

julia_partners: Can we also lock down the embargo date? GCP asked for an earliest publish window — prefer to hold until we confirm EdgeWorks press approval. Proposed embargo: 2026-04-08. If that works, I'll coordinate comms.

mike_security: Works for me. I'll include that date in the SOC/pen packet as the release policy.

anil_eng: I sent EdgeWorks an approval request. If they request changes, I'll update and re-upload the attestation blob.

sam_fieldeng: Uploaded README and presigned links. Sharing here: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-partner-evidence/edgeworks/marketplace/1780045555/?region=us-west-2 (presigned links sent separately).

julia_partners: Perfect. Next steps summary: mike finalize SOC + pen summary, anil confirm signed attestation and redaction, sam maintain artifact bundle + presigned links, i'll confirm embargo and notify GCP reviewer. Tagging owners in the calendar invite. :thumbsup:

mike_security: Thanks — will post drafts here for quick review before upload.

anil_eng: Will follow up once EdgeWorks responds.

sam_fieldeng: Available for quick redaction/metadata help if needed.

julia_partners: Closing loop — target to have everything to reviewer by 2026-03-30. If blockers, flag here.
